approved: Education Services for Overseas Students Amendment Bill 2017
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill makes technical updates to the Education Services for Overseas Students Act 2000 to align it with changes in the TPS Levies Act 2012.
It gives the Minister power to manage the Overseas Students Tuition Fund, which is funded by levies on education providers, to keep its balance within a recommended range.
The government expects a one-off cut to the administrative and base fee components, and says the fee levels might not be reviewed annually.
Amends the ESOS Act to reflect changes made by the TPS Levies Amendment Bill 2017.
Authorises the Minister to proactively manage the Fund's reserves.
Enables a reduction in the administrative and base fees to keep the Fund within the target range.
International education providers and international students, as well as the Minister and the Tuition Protection Service.

The member moved the second reading of the Education Services for Overseas Students Amendment Bill 2017, which amends two Acts to reduce financial burdens on education providers while improving student protection, and clarifies how the Tuition Protection Service (TPS) Director calculates provider levies.
The Education for Overseas Students (TPS Levies) Amendment Bill and the Education Services for Overseas Students Amendment Bill 2017 were referred to the Federation Chamber for further consideration.
